gloss: faculty of education; school of education

definitions.gloss: faculty of education; school of education
definitions.explanation: The university division that studies education and trains teachers.

examples.japanese: {教育学部|きょういくがくぶ}で{学|まな}んでいる。
examples.english: I'm studying in the faculty of education.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{教育学部|きょういくがくぶ}を{出|で}て{教師|きょうし}になった。
examples.english: He graduated from the faculty of education and became a teacher.

examples.japanese: {教育学部|きょういくがくぶ}では{教員免許|きょういんめんきょ}を{取|と}るための{科目|かもく}を{学|まな}ぶ。
examples.english: In the faculty of education you study courses for earning a teaching license.

notes:
Compound of {教育|きょういく} (education) + {学部|がくぶ} (faculty). Most graduates pursue a teaching license, though the faculty also covers educational research.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教育学部|きょういくがくぶ}に{進|すす}む: to go on to the faculty of education
- {教育学部|きょういくがくぶ}の{付属校|ふぞくこう}: a school attached to the faculty of education
- {国立|こくりつ}{大学|だいがく}の{教育学部|きょういくがくぶ}: the faculty of education at a national university
